title: 噬菌体在清除生物危害中的作用
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/57_What role do bacteriophages play in removing biological hazards microbiology tre.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/57_What role do bacteriophages play in removing biological hazards microbiology tre/src.py

points.K1: 噬菌体：专杀特定细菌的病毒
points.K2: 精准清除污水和医院里的致病菌
points.K3: 微生物能间接中和强酸强碱
points.K4: 嗜酸菌：把硫酸变成单质硫
points.K5: 嗜碱菌：产有机酸，把碱降下来
points.K6: 生物滤池：微生物把有毒气体当食物
points.K7: 去氨、去硫化氢的两种菌

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在污水处理池模型旁，身旁浮着一个噬菌体图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a model of a wastewater treatment tank, a floating bacteriophage icon with a head and spider-like legs beside it, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 有一种病毒，专门帮我们杀细菌。
overlay: 噬菌体在清除生物危害中的作用

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣指向三个图标：噬菌体、酸碱试纸、烟囱
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to three floating icons: a bacteriophage, a pH test strip, and a chimney with fumes.
shots.narration: 还有微生物能对付酸碱和臭气。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一瓶浑浊的污水样，准备倒进培养瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a bottle of murky wastewater sample with a blank label at an open bench, about to pour it.
shots.narration: 阿杰想从污水里分离噬菌体。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰看着污水样，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at the cloudy water sample with a question mark above his head.
shots.narration: 他问：病毒也能帮忙治污？

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 分三道题，一起看看。

shots.section_title: 噬菌体：专杀特定细菌的病毒
shots.scene: 噬菌体落在一个杆菌表面，把尾巴扎进去
shots.prompt_en: A bacteriophage lands on the surface of a rod-shaped bacterium and pushes its tail into it. No people.
shots.narration: 噬菌体，是感染细菌的病毒。
overlay: 噬菌体：专杀特定细菌的病毒

shots.section_title: 噬菌体：专杀特定细菌的病毒
shots.scene: 细菌里冒出许多小噬菌体，细菌破裂
shots.prompt_en: Many small bacteriophages form inside the bacterium, which then bursts open. No people.
shots.narration: 它在细菌里复制，再把细菌撑破。

shots.section_title: 噬菌体：专杀特定细菌的病毒
shots.scene: 噬菌体只停在一种颜色的细菌上，别的颜色不碰
shots.prompt_en: Bacteriophages land only on bacteria of one color and ignore bacteria of other colors. No people.
shots.narration: 而且只认特定的细菌。

shots.section_title: 精准清除污水和医院里的致病菌
shots.scene: 污水池里，噬菌体围住带红色警示的致病菌
shots.prompt_en: In a wastewater tank, bacteriophages surround bacteria marked with small red warning dots. No people.
shots.narration: 在污水里，它能盯住致病菌，
overlay: 精准清除污水和医院里的致病菌

shots.section_title: 精准清除污水和医院里的致病菌
shots.scene: 医院建筑图标旁，带红点的细菌被噬菌体消灭
shots.prompt_en: Beside a hospital building icon, bacteria with red warning dots are destroyed by bacteriophages. No people.
shots.narration: 医院环境里，也能派上用场。

shots.section_title: 精准清除污水和医院里的致病菌
shots.scene: 绿色的有益菌安然无恙，旁边绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: Green beneficial bacteria remain untouched, with a green check mark beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 有益的微生物，它不伤害。

shots.section_title: 微生物能间接中和强酸强碱
shots.scene: 工厂排水管流出两股水，一股带酸象形图，一股带碱
shots.prompt_en: A factory drain releases two streams, each marked with a corrosive pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 工业废水，常常酸碱很强。
overlay: 微生物能间接中和强酸强碱

shots.section_title: 微生物能间接中和强酸强碱
shots.scene: 微生物不直接碰酸碱，而是放出小分子改变水质
shots.prompt_en: Microbes in the water release small molecules that slowly change the water color toward neutral green. No people.
shots.narration: 微生物能帮忙，但是间接的。

shots.section_title: 嗜酸菌：把硫酸变成单质硫
shots.scene: 酸性的红色水里，一群细菌照样活跃
shots.prompt_en: In red acidic water, a group of bacteria stays lively and active. No people.
shots.narration: 嗜酸菌，比如酸硫杆菌，
overlay: 嗜酸菌：把硫酸变成单质硫

shots.section_title: 嗜酸菌：把硫酸变成单质硫
shots.scene: 细菌周围的酸性液体里析出黄色的硫颗粒
shots.prompt_en: Yellow sulfur particles appear and change around the bacteria. No people.
shots.narration: 在酸性废物里生长，把硫酸变成单质硫。

shots.section_title: 嗜碱菌：产有机酸，把碱降下来
shots.scene: 蓝紫色的碱性水里，杆菌活跃
shots.prompt_en: In blue-purple alkaline water, rod-shaped bacteria are active. No people.
shots.narration: 嗜碱菌，比如耐盐芽孢杆菌，
overlay: 嗜碱菌：产有机酸，把碱降下来

shots.section_title: 嗜碱菌：产有机酸，把碱降下来
shots.scene: 细菌放出小酸滴，水色从蓝紫变成绿色
shots.prompt_en: The bacteria release small acid droplets and the water color changes from blue-purple to green. No people.
shots.narration: 会产生有机酸，把碱性废水的pH降下来。

shots.section_title: 生物滤池：微生物把有毒气体当食物
shots.scene: 生物滤池剖面：一层层滤料，表面长满细菌膜
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a biofilter tower: layers of packing material whose surfaces are covered with bacterial film. No people.
shots.narration: 生物滤池和生物反应器，
overlay: 生物滤池：微生物把有毒气体当食物

shots.section_title: 生物滤池：微生物把有毒气体当食物
shots.scene: 带骷髅象形图的臭气从底部进入，向上穿过滤料
shots.prompt_en: Smelly gas with a skull pictogram enters from the bottom and rises through the packing layers. No people.
shots.narration: 让有毒气体从滤料中间穿过，

shots.section_title: 生物滤池：微生物把有毒气体当食物
shots.scene: 细菌把气体分子吃掉，顶部出来的是干净空气
shots.prompt_en: The bacteria absorb the gas molecules, and clean air comes out of the top. No people.
shots.narration: 长在表面的微生物，把气体当食物吃掉。

shots.section_title: 去氨、去硫化氢的两种菌
shots.scene: 一种细菌抓住氨分子，变成另一个分子
shots.prompt_en: One kind of bacterium grabs an ammonia molecule icon and turns it into a different molecule icon. No people.
shots.narration: 亚硝化单胞菌，把氨氧化成亚硝酸盐。
overlay: 去氨、去硫化氢的两种菌

shots.section_title: 去氨、去硫化氢的两种菌
shots.scene: 另一种细菌抓住硫化氢分子，变成硫酸盐
shots.prompt_en: Another kind of bacterium grabs a hydrogen sulfide molecule icon and turns it into a sulfate icon. No people.
shots.narration: 硫杆菌，把硫化氢氧化成硫酸盐。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣站在三个图标前：噬菌体、酸碱试纸、生物滤池
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of three icons: a bacteriophage, a pH strip and a biofilter tower.
shots.narration: 一起回顾一下。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 噬菌体攻击带红点的细菌，绿色细菌无恙
shots.prompt_en: Bacteriophages attack bacteria with red dots while green bacteria stay unharmed. No people.
shots.narration: 噬菌体精准杀致病菌，不伤有益菌。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 水色由红、蓝变成绿色，滤池顶部出干净空气
shots.prompt_en: Red and blue water turn green, and clean air comes out of a biofilter tower. No people.
shots.narration: 微生物间接调酸碱，滤池吃掉臭气。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研一起挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 小小微生物，治污大本事，下次见！
